// Real CLI against Tarsee's OWN loopback MCP endpoint (the Node src/ai/mcp-http.js that Codex uses today, and that the
// Rust ai/mcp_http.rs replaces): the program is pointed at it with --mcp-config, the bearer token comes from the
// environment (${TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN}), and the fake Messages API scripts a call to tarsee_datetime, then a Bash command
// that says whether the token is in the agent's shell.
import fs from "node:fs";
import http from "node:http";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { SCRATCH, NODE_PROJECT } from "./capture-lib.mjs"; // sets Tarsee's folders to the scratch folder first
import { drive, gatewayEnv, baseArgs, initRequest, userText, startFakeAnthropic } from "./real-drive.mjs";

const { startMcpHttp, grantTurn, stopMcpHttp } = await import(pathToFileURL(`${NODE_PROJECT}/src/ai/mcp-http.js`).href);
fs.mkdirSync(`${SCRATCH}/real`, { recursive: true });

const toolNames = (body) => (body?.tools || []).map((x) => x.name);
const toolResults = (body) => (body?.messages || []).flatMap((m) => (Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content.filter((b) => b.type === "tool_result") : []));

const quiet = console.log; console.log = () => {};
const endpoint = await startMcpHttp({ stateDir: `${SCRATCH}/tarsee-state` });
console.log = quiet;
// a recording pass-through in front of the endpoint, to see the requests (the endpoint itself logs nothing)
const seen = [];
const front = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const chunks = [];
  req.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
  req.on("end", () => {
    const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks);
    let body = null; try { body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8")); } catch { /* none */ }
    const entry = { method: req.method, path: req.url, headers: { ...req.headers }, body };
    seen.push(entry);
    const up = http.request({ host: "127.0.0.1", port: endpoint.port, path: req.url, method: req.method, headers: { ...req.headers, host: `127.0.0.1:${endpoint.port}` } }, (r) => {
      const out = [];
      r.on("data", (c) => out.push(c));
      r.on("end", () => {
        const text = Buffer.concat(out).toString("utf8");
        entry.status = r.statusCode; entry.responseHeaders = r.headers;
        try { entry.response = JSON.parse(text); } catch { entry.response = text; }
        res.writeHead(r.statusCode, r.headers); res.end(text);
      });
    });
    up.on("error", (e) => { entry.error = String(e); res.writeHead(502); res.end(); });
    up.end(raw);
  });
});
await new Promise((r) => front.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", r));
const frontUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${front.address().port}/mcp`;

const grant = await grantTurn({}, { turnId: "capture-turn-1" });
const fake = await startFakeAnthropic({
  script: (req) => {
    const done = toolResults(req.body).length;
    if (done === 0 && toolNames(req.body).includes("mcp__tarsee__tarsee_datetime")) return { toolUse: { id: "toolu_mcp_1", name: "mcp__tarsee__tarsee_datetime", input: { timezone: "UTC", format: "iso" } } };
    if (done === 1) return { toolUse: { id: "toolu_bash_1", name: "Bash", input: { command: 'if [ -n "$TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN" ]; then echo MCP_TOKEN_IN_SHELL; else echo MCP_TOKEN_NOT_IN_SHELL; fi; if [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then echo AUTH_TOKEN_IN_SHELL; else echo AUTH_TOKEN_NOT_IN_SHELL; fi', description: "look" } } };
    return { text: done ? "Done." : "No tarsee tool was offered." };
  },
});
try {
  for (const [label, name, url] of [["straight at Tarsee's endpoint", "06-mcp-node-endpoint", grant.url], ["through a recording pass-through", "06-mcp-node-endpoint-recorded", frontUrl]]) {
    fake.requests.length = 0;
    const cfg = { mcpServers: { tarsee: { type: "http", url, headers: { Authorization: "Bearer ${TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN}" }, alwaysLoad: true } } };
    const r = await drive({
      name, args: baseArgs({ extra: ["--mcp-config", JSON.stringify(cfg)] }),
      env: gatewayEnv(`${SCRATCH}/homes/${name}`, fake.url, { CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_READS_SESSION_STATE: "1", TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN: grant.token }), cwd: `${SCRATCH}/ws/${name}`,
      stdin: [initRequest({ systemPrompt: ["You are a test."], systemPromptSnapshot: false }), userText("what time is it?")], timeoutMs: 120_000,
    });
    const msgs = r.stdout.map((o) => o.msg).filter(Boolean);
    const init = msgs.find((m) => m.type === "system" && m.subtype === "init");
    console.log(`\n===== ${label}: exit ${r.exitCode}; stderr ${JSON.stringify(r.stderr.slice(0, 300))}`);
    console.log("  init.mcp_servers:", JSON.stringify(init?.mcp_servers));
    console.log("  init.tools:", init?.tools.length, "tools;", init?.tools.filter((x) => x.startsWith("mcp__")).length, "of them mcp__tarsee__*:", JSON.stringify(init?.tools.filter((x) => x.startsWith("mcp__"))));
    for (const m of msgs) {
      if (m.type === "assistant" || m.type === "user") console.log(`  < ${m.type} ${JSON.stringify(m.message.content).slice(0, 400)}`);
      if (m.type === "result") console.log(`  < result ${m.subtype} is_error=${m.is_error} result=${JSON.stringify(m.result)}`);
    }
    console.log("  tools offered in the first API request:", toolNames(fake.messages()[0]?.body).length, "; tarsee ones:", toolNames(fake.messages()[0]?.body).filter((x) => x.startsWith("mcp__")).length);
    fs.writeFileSync(`${SCRATCH}/real/${name}.api-tools.json`, JSON.stringify(fake.messages().map((q) => toolNames(q.body)), null, 2));
  }
  console.log("\n  the endpoint saw (through the pass-through):");
  for (const q of seen) {
    console.log(`    ${q.method} ${q.path} -> ${q.status}  request=${JSON.stringify(q.body)?.slice(0, 300)}`);
    console.log(`      response=${JSON.stringify(q.response)?.slice(0, 400)}  content-type=${q.responseHeaders?.["content-type"]}`);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(`${SCRATCH}/real/06-mcp-node-endpoint.requests.json`, JSON.stringify(seen, null, 2).replaceAll(grant.token, "<TOKEN>"));
} finally {
  grant.revoke();
  await fake.close();
  await new Promise((r) => front.close(r));
  await stopMcpHttp();
}
